meta.name: Ensure S3 bucket Object is encrypted by KMS using a customer managed Key (CMK)
meta.description: Ensure S3 bucket Object is encrypted by KMS using a customer managed Key (CMK)
meta.remediation: Set kms_key_id to a customer managed KMS key on every aws_s3_bucket_object.

evaluators.description: kms_key_id must be a non-empty string. IsNotEmpty fails on null, and an unresolvable attribute is a severity-2 miss that also fails at error_tolerance 1.
